EditionSuggestionOut.description:
An open suggested age above an Edition's: rating the Work leaves it open and the Edition
stays out of the shelves below 18+ until `rate_edition`.
EditionSuggestionOut.title: EditionSuggestionOut

HealthPageOut.description:
The Health page (EF-SRC-014, EF-BIB-031, EF-BIB-051, EF-INT-015, EF-INT-025). The nested
documents are typed by the code of their entries; none holds a secret, a phrase or a path.
HealthPageOut.title: HealthPageOut

JobAccepted.description: Body of a 202: the job to poll (the same URL is in the `Location` header).
JobAccepted.title: JobAccepted

NamingPreviewOut.description: `verified` false is the "not verified" mark: Kavita could not confirm the names.
NamingPreviewOut.title: NamingPreviewOut

NamingTemplateIn.description: The fields of a candidate template; what is left out is the default's.
NamingTemplateIn.title: NamingTemplateIn

PasskeyFlow.description: A challenge and the browser options for `navigator.credentials` (base64url fields).
PasskeyFlow.title: PasskeyFlow

PasskeyReauth.description: The assertion answers a challenge from `/api/v1/auth/passkeys/reauth/options`.
PasskeyReauth.title: PasskeyReauth

PreferencesIn.description: Only what is named is changed; `theme: null` goes back to the instance default.
PreferencesIn.title: PreferencesIn

Problem.description: RFC 9457 body, as documented in the OpenAPI schema.
Problem.title: Problem

RatedOut.description:
The Work is rated; the files a raised age no longer lets stay on a shelf below 18+ are
listed in `withdrawals` and nothing was taken out (`shelf withdraw`, EF-BIB-037).
RatedOut.title: RatedOut

ReauthRequiredProblem.description:
`reauth-required` (EF-USR-022): how old the last password entry is, and the age allowed.
Nothing else about the session leaves with it. `-1`: no usable `auth_time`.
ReauthRequiredProblem.title: ReauthRequiredProblem

RootIn.description:
`path`: a folder the database does not know yet (`foreign_root` found by the start-up),
named by its absolute path instead of the `root_id` of the URL.
RootIn.title: RootIn

SearchedInOut.description: One line of "Searched in...": a source that was asked, by key and name (never an address).
SearchedInOut.title: SearchedInOut

SecretsImportIn.description:
Two plain file names in `<data folder>/import/` on the host of the server: the passphrase
never travels in the request, and the caller picks no path.
SecretsImportIn.title: SecretsImportIn

WorkOut.description: A Work as the sources name it; `appended`: it was shown before, these Editions are new.
WorkOut.title: WorkOut
